answer: Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the kernel queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 122 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the reef. The karst index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 381 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
